Chrome 152 and Edge 152 cannot receive SysEx dumps from a USB device on macOS. You are on this version, so receiving will not work — the device sends, and nothing arrives. Sending to the device is unaffected, as is everything that does not touch MIDI. Update to Chromium 153 or later, which receives again, or use a Chromium browser still on 151. This is a browser bug, not a fault in this app.
